item.title: Bulletin updated at 07:50 HKT 07/Apr/2026
item.author: hkowm@hko.gov.hk (Hong Kong Observatory)
item.description:
General Situation:
Under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot during the day and the weather will be brighter over the coast of Guangdong today. An easterly airstream will bring one or two rain patches to the coast of Guangdong tomorrow. An anticyclone aloft is expected to cover the coast of southern China and the northern part of the South China Sea in the latter part of this week to early next week. The weather will improve over the region. Meanwhile, under the influence of a southerly airstream, it will be hot during the day over the region.
